Modern 2BR Condo Room Sublet — 514 King St W, Kitchener, ON (ION to UW!)

Looking for a clean UW or Laurier co-op student to take my bedroom from Jan 1 to Apr 30, 2027. Steps from Central Station ION & UW School of Pharmacy (about 15 min on the LRT right to UW campus). The condo owner lives in Mississauga so you only share the unit with one friendly Pharmacy student. Happy to set up an in-person walkthrough or a live video call if you're currently out of town. Reach out at kitchener514@example.com.
